mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document ( document_type, title, content, employee_id, approval_type, status, is_urgent ) VALUES ( #{documentType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{employeeId}, #{approvalType}, #{status}, #{isUrgent} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM document WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND status = 'DRAFT' ORDER BY doc_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE document SET title = #{title} , content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW(), is_urgent =#{isUrgent} WHERE doc_id = #{docId} AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND status = 'DRAFT'
